test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 25 July 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.**

An eye opener
solution:
The correct answer is__** A shocking revelation**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The meaning of the above idiom is **something that reveals truth about something.**
 
• When someone describes something as an eye opener, it means that it surprises them and teaches them something new.
 
 
• Examples : Last year was really **an eye opener** for me, Travelling around the city was **an eye opener** for me.
 
 
 
• Thus, the correct answer is **Option 2.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Some more idioms are :
 
• **Under the weather** - to feel ill, Ex - I am feeling a bit **under the weather** today.
 
• **Spill the beans - To share a secret, Ex - Marry spilled the beans** in whole campus.
 
• **Through thick and thin - to stay loyal in every condition, Ex - I will always love you through thick and thin**.
